notes.title: Duck's Despair Release date: January 26 !
notes.content:
Dear Folks,

I'm happy to announce the release date for Duck's Despair, January 26th!

It's been a long and tiring journey through the whole year of 2023 to bring this game to birth.
I am very happy to have made it within my deadlines!

Play the demo, share the words with your friends, and prepare for an unforgiving journey that will take you to the depths of your own madness.

Happy New Year!

notes.title: New Demo!
notes.content:
Dear folks,

I just uploaded the final version of the demo.
Most levels in that demo are different from the previous version, so make sure to give it a try!

Since every level has been through a rework, I had to reset the save file.
However, the progression you unlock starting from now, will be carried over to the full version of the game!

Steam doesn't allow for achievements to be unlocked from a demo, but don't worry, your achievements are saved under the hood, and you'll unlock all those you achieved as soon as you launch the full version.

Oh, by the way, have you seen the new trailer?

I am very excited to hear your feedback.

notes.title: Achievements!
notes.content:
Hey folks, 
I've been working hard recently to keep up with my deadlines.

I will soon update the demo so you can try the first 18 definitive levels of the game.
And right now I've just setted up the achievements so you can see for yourself what kind of challenges await in the full release.

Thanks for being so patient, I'll give more news in the future.
I'll soon announce the release date ;)

Take care.

notes.title: Developer's Play!
notes.content:
Join me for the Steam Next Fest, as I will be streaming Duck's Despair!
I will attempt to beat my own best times, and speedrun a complete playthrough.

notes.title: Update 0.41
notes.content:
This small update introduce a new piece of lore, as an interlude level after you beat level 30.
Therefore the other interlude levels have been moved, respectively after level 10 and level 20.

If you already beaten the game, simply play the level 30 again to discover this new scenario.

I also moved the background position in many levels, resulting in a better readability.

notes.title: Demo v0.3 is Here !
notes.content:
Hi team!

I'm thrilled to present you with this 0.3, I'm sure you'll like what I've prepared for you. I'am very curious about how you felt playing so don't hesitate and hop in the Discord to give me your feedback!

[h1]Patch note[/h1]

[h2]Major features:
[/h2]

[list]
[*] Bonus levels! Unlock them by gathering enough eggs.
[*] New gameplay with spring platform !
[*] New gameplay with wind turbine!
[*] Hardcore mode: try to beat as many level as you can without without dying!
[*] Instant respawn option!
[*] Intro has been reworked with a better scenario and tutorial.
[/list]
[h2]
Physics adjustments:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a slight air control for smoother controls 
[*] Smaller hitbox height, because some of you were bonking their head on ceilings
[*] Time to execute wall jump increased: from 0.4s to 0.64
[*] Wall jump speed bonus increased: from 1.5x to 1.75 nominal speed.
[*] Duck doesn't stay on wall anymore if sliding off.
[/list]

[h2]Other:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Four new levels to ease the difficulty curve.
[*] Rusty platform and feathers now respawn automatically.
[*] Dialogues now make sounds.
[*] Dialogues now are skippable.
[*] New UI with new font.
[*] Improved some sounds mix.
[*] Blinking animation when duck is tired 
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] A ton... Trust me.
[/list]

notes.title: Demo available
notes.content:
Dear friends,

After month of hard work, I'm very glad to present you the demo of Duck's Despair !
It contains 26 levels for you to discover the core features of the game, and the beggining of the story.

Keep in mind it's far from being final product, and many more surprises will arrive over the course of the next updates.

You opinion is very precious to me therefore I'd be super happy to receive your feedback. You may either [url=https://discord.gg/m7777jkaCU]reach out on Discord[/url], or leave a review on Steam.

I'll keep updating the Demo until the Steam Next Fest in october, so stay tuned in ;)

See you soon, take care.
